visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman sits cross-legged on a bed in a bedroom. She wears a grey t-shirt and glasses, holding a large brown folder designed to look like a Hogwarts acceptance letter. The room is warmly lit with a nightstand and pillows visible in the background. (2) She opens the folder and uses a thin wooden wand to point at the personalized text 'Miss Crown Du' written on the inner paper. The camera moves closer to capture the details of the wax seal and the printed calligraphy on the document. (3) The scene shifts to the floor, where a large rug shaped like an oversized, slightly crumpled letter is spread out. The woman sits on the rug and gestures to its edges to show its massive size compared to the surrounding furniture. (4) She lies down completely on the rug to demonstrate that it is longer than her height. The floor is wooden, and a circular rug with more text is partially visible beneath the larger letter-shaped rug. (5) She sits back up and presents a brown sorting hat and a pink eye mask to the lens. She holds them in front of her face while talking excitedly, pointing at the hat with her wand before concluding with a close-up of the original letter folder.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Feature Showcase -> Lifestyle Contextualization -> Promotional Incentive -> Personal Statement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase and promote Harry Potter themed bedroom merchandise, specifically a large Hogwarts letter rug and a personalized letter folder. By adopting a playful 'witch' persona and highlighting a limited-time bonus eye mask for early buyers, the creator engages fans of the franchise and drives consumer interest in the products.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, mention of a specific promotional offer (eye mask for first 100 orders), and clearly showing the product packaging and brand logos.
